title: Pattern recognition: TLR2, NOD2, and cord-factor lectins
dek: Mtb is seen by several innate receptors at once (lipoproteins/LAM via TLR2, muramyl dipeptide via NOD2, TDM via MINCLE). MyD88 and downstream cytokines are the shared trunk. This is not a diagnostic panel.
story: Macrophages do not recognise “M. tuberculosis” as a species name. They bind molecular patterns: mannose-capped LAM and some lipoproteins through TLR2 (with heterodimer partners), peptidoglycan fragments including muramyl dipeptide through NOD2, and trehalose dimycolate (cord factor) through MINCLE and related C-type lectins. Several receptors fire on one bacillus. Knocking out one in a mouse is not a complete innate-blind animal.

Adaptor logic: many TLRs use MyD88; NOD2 uses RIP2. Downstream NF-κB and interferon-stimulated programmes produce TNF, IL-12, and chemokines that recruit the adaptive layer. Mendelian MyD88/IRAK4 defects are more often pyogenic-bacteria stories than classic MSMD, which is a reminder that TB control is not a single TLR.

ManLAM of pathogenic mycobacteria is a quieter TLR agonist than some NTM PILAM stories; that is envelope chemistry (own LAM plate), not a reason to skip immunology. None of these receptors is an Xpert probe.
deepTitle: What to keep, what to leave in the review article
deep: Vitamin D / cathelicidin and autophagy papers sit downstream of some of these receptors. They are research-layer. They do not change HRZE.
Anti-TNF remains the clinical innate/adaptive hole you actually screen for. TLR SNPs in GWAS are population priors, not individual TPT rules.
ESX-1 and phagosome rupture change which ligands become cytosolic (NOD2) versus vacuolar. Pathogenesis plates own that geometry.
Do not order a “TLR panel” to diagnose pulmonary TB.

visual.caption: Three ligand classes onto three receptor names, then a shared cytokine trunk toward IL-12/TNF. The adaptive plate sits off this map; DST does not sit on it at all.

example.title: A TLR2 SNP is not TPT
example.setup: A GWAS hits a TLR2 intron in a TB-susceptibility paper. A clinic asks whether to skip TPT in contacts who lack the risk allele.

steps.title: Population prior ≠ individual rule
steps.body: A modest odds ratio on a receptor SNP is a population association. It does not measure this contact’s macrophage killing and does not replace exposure history.

steps.title: The clinical innate hole you already know
steps.body: Anti-TNF, HIV, and MSMD change TPT decisions. A TLR2 genotype does not.

steps.title: Keep the map for reading papers
steps.body: When a paper claims “Mtb is not seen by innate immunity,” ask which ligand–receptor pair they actually deleted. This plate is that checklist.

example.takeaway: Several receptors see Mtb. None of them is a TPT assay.
